original: シャーリィ、本当に苦しくなったら\n我慢しないで言ってね
traducao: Shirley, if it gets truly painful,\ndon't hold back, okay? Tell us.

original: カノンノさん……ありがとう。\nでも、わたしは大丈夫
traducao: Kanonno... Thank you.\nStill, I'll be fine.

original: 決めたんです。\nわたしは、わたしにやれる事は\n出来るだけやっていこうって
traducao: I've made up my mind.\nI want to do whatever I can to help,\nas much as possible.

original: 誰かが何かをしてくれるのを\n待っているだけじゃダメなんです
traducao: Just waiting for someone else\nto do something won't do.

original: そうやって、\n後になって後悔するのも……
traducao: Doing that, and ending up\nregretting it later...

original: そのせいで、誰かが傷付くのを\n見ているだけなのも\nわたしはもう、したくないから
traducao: And just watching someone get hurt\nbecause of it... I don't want\nto do that anymore.

original: うん……そっか
traducao: Yeah... I see.

original: でも、くれぐれも無理はしないでね。\nシャーリィに何かあったら\nセネルに私達が怒られちゃうよ
traducao: Still, please don't overdo it.\nIf anything happened to you, Shirley,\nSenel would get mad at us!
Right, ○○?

original: アドリビトムも、人が増えましたよねぇ。\n老若男女問わず、色んな人が\n集まってるって感じです
traducao: Ad Libitum has gotten so many people.\nYoung and old, men and women alike,\nall sorts have gathered together.

original: そうね。\n若い人だけじゃなくて\n年配の方も結構多いし……
traducao: You're right.\nNot just young people, there are quite\na few older folks as well...

original: あらあら、それって、\nおっさんの事言ってるの〜？
traducao: My, my... Could you be talking\nabout this old man here~?

original: レイヴンは若い方に入るのではないか？
traducao: Wouldn't Raven count as one of the young?

original: わ〜お。\nクロエちゃんたら、\n優しいんだから∀　もう∀
traducao: Waaao.\nChloe, you're so sweet to me!\nAw, shucks!

original: い……いや、そんな事は……
traducao: N-No, that wasn't...

original: レイヴンさんぐらいだったら、\n年配って言い方よりも、\nおじ様って感じですよね
traducao: For someone like Raven,\nrather than saying elderly, it feels\nmore like a distinguished gent.

original: 何よ〜、チェルシーちゃんまで∀\nおっさん、嬉し過ぎて泣いちゃうよ〜
traducao: Aw, even Chelsea!?\nThis old man might just cry from joy~

original: うんうん、で？
traducao: Uh-huh, uh-huh, and?

original: え？　\n……わたし？
traducao: Eh?\n...Me?

original: いや、何か、順番的に、\nお言葉もらえるかと思いまして∀
traducao: Well, going in order, I figured\nI might get some kind words from you!

original: は、はい……。\n素敵……、だと、思います……
traducao: Y-Yes...\nI think... you're wonderful...

original: いやー、参っちゃうね〜。\n困っちゃうね〜
traducao: Man oh man, this is too much~\nWhat am I gonna do~?

original: おっさん、こ〜んなにモテモテなんて、\nいやー、どうしよ、ほんとどうしよ〜
traducao: For this old guy to be so popular,\nman, what to do, what to do~?

original: 早速、自慢しに行っちゃおうっと∀
traducao: I'm gonna go brag about this right now!

original: クーリッジ……
traducao: Coolidge...

original: お兄ちゃん！
traducao: Big brother!

original: ごめんね、少し\n支度に手間取っちゃって……。\n待った……よね？
traducao: Sorry, getting ready took\na little longer than expected...\nYou waited... didn't you?

original: いや、そんな事はないさ
traducao: Nah, not at all.

original: 本当？　\n良かった……
traducao: Really?\nWhat a relief...

original: それにしても、シャーリィは大げさだな。\n買い出しに行くくらいで、そんなに\n身だしなみを気にしなくてもいいだろ
traducao: You're exaggerating, Shirley.\nWe're just shopping, you didn't need\nto fuss over your looks so much.

original: そうはいかないよ。\nだって、せっかくお兄ちゃんと……
traducao: Of course I do.\nI mean, I'm finally with you...

original: …？　\n何だ？
traducao: ...?\nWhat?

original: ……ううん、何でもない。\n行こ！
traducao: ...No, it's nothing.\nLet's go!

original: クーリッジ……
traducao: Coolidge...

original: （うっかり立ち聞きしちゃった……けど）
traducao: (I accidentally overheard... but)

original: （もしかしなくても、これって\n　三角関係！？）
traducao: (Could this be...\na love triangle!?!)

original: （すごい……すごいわ！\n　この後の展開が気になる……っ）
traducao: (Amazing... This is amazing!\n I have to know what happens next...!)

original: シャーリィ？　\n何をしてるの？
traducao: Shirley?\nWhat are you doing?

original: あ……コハクさん
traducao: Ah... Kohaku.

original: あの、お兄ちゃんを見なかった？
traducao: Um, have you seen my big brother?

original: セネル？　\nわたしは見てないよ
traducao: Senel?\nI haven't seen him.

original: そう……
traducao: I see...

original: セネルに何かあったの？\n……まさか、行方不明になってるとか！？
traducao: Did something happen to Senel?\n...Wait, don't tell me he went missing!?

original: ううん、そうじゃないの
traducao: No, it's not like that.

original: お兄ちゃん、色んな所で\n寝ちゃうクセがあって……朝起きたら\nまた部屋にいなかったから……
traducao: He has a habit of sleeping all over\nthe place... When I woke up, he wasn't\nin our room again...

original: この船のどこかで寝てるかも\nしれない……って事？
traducao: So he might be asleep somewhere\non this ship...?

original: はい、多分
traducao: Yes, most likely.

original: こう広いと、毎朝探すのが\n大変で……
traducao: With the ship being so huge, searching\nevery morning is quite an ordeal...

original: シャーリィ……
traducao: Shirley...

original: わかった、そういう事なら\nわたしも手伝うよ！
traducao: Got it! If that's the case,\nI'll help you look too!

original: でも……
いいの、いいの。\n同じ妹同士、協力しよう？
traducao: Don't worry about it!\nAs fellow little sisters, let's team up!

original: その方が絶対、早く見つかるよ！　ね？
traducao: We'll definitely find him faster! Right?

original: ……ありがとう、コハクさん
traducao: ...Thank you, Kohaku.

original: そういえばさ、ロックスって\nどういうタイプの女の子が好きなの？
traducao: Come to think of it, Rocks,\nwhat kind of girls do you like?

original: 好きなタイプ……ですか？\nそうですね、健康的な女性が\n好ましいと思います
traducao: The type I like...? Let me see...\nI believe healthy, robust women\nare most desirable.

original: 健康的な女性、ですか？\nつまり、それってどういう……？
traducao: Healthy women? Um...\nWhat exactly do you mean by that...?

original: 簡単ですよ。\n美味しい物をモリモリ食べて\n豊かに成長をされた方、ですね
traducao: It is quite simple.\nThose who eat plenty of good food,\nand grow up richly endowed.

original: 豊かに……
traducao: Richly...

original: 成長……？
traducao: Endowed...?

original: はい……∀
traducao: Yes...

original: （あれ……ロックスって……\n　もしかして、ちょっと危ない人？）
traducao: (Wait... Could Rocks be...\na bit of a dangerous person?)

original: ロックスさんて\n危ない人だったんですね
traducao: So you're a dangerous person,\nRocks.

original: シャーリィ、それは声に出しちゃダメ！
traducao: Shirley, don't say that out loud!

original: ねえ、カノンノ？\nカノンノは、ロックスと\nずっと一緒に暮らしてきたんだよね
traducao: Hey, Kanonno?\nYou've lived together with Rocks\nall this time, right?

original: うん、そうだよ
traducao: Yeah, that's right.

original: あの……ロックスさんは\nどうして女性に、ご飯をたくさん\n食べさせたがるんでしょう？
traducao: Um... Why is it that Rocks always\nwants women to eat\nso much food?

original: ……私も、詳しくは知らないんだけど\n昔、とっても過酷な環境で\n生活していた事があったんだって
traducao: ...I don't know all the details,\nbut he once lived in a very harsh\nenvironment long ago.

original: ご飯がきちんと食べられなくて、\n人がどんどん痩せていって……
traducao: People couldn't eat properly,\nand kept getting thinner and thinner...

original: ……ひどい……
traducao: ...How awful...

original: だから、ご飯は食べられる時に\nきちんと食べて欲しいって\n思ってるのかもしれないよ
traducao: So when food is available, he might\njust want people to eat well\nwhile they have the chance.

original: そんな事情があったんですね
traducao: So that was the reason.

original: ロックスも、色々と複雑なんだ……
traducao: Rocks has his own complex past...

original: （危ない人かも、なんて思って\n　悪い事しちゃったな……）
traducao: (I feel bad for thinking\n he was a dangerous guy...)

original: 危ない趣味なんて言って、\n悪い事しちゃいましたね……
traducao: I feel bad for saying he had\na dangerous hobby...

original: でも、ぽっちゃりしたくない\n女性にとっては、やっぱり敵ですね
traducao: Still, for women who don't want to get\nchubby, he's definitely the enemy.

original: ねえ、シャーリィ？\nちょっと聞いたんだけど……
traducao: Hey, Shirley?\nI heard a little rumor, but...

original: シャーリィは泳ぐのが\nとっても上手って、本当？
traducao: Is it true that you're really,\nreally good at swimming?

original: もう、お兄ちゃんね……。\nまたそんな事言ったの……
traducao: Oh, big brother...\nDid he go around saying that again...?

original: うん
traducao: Yeah.

original: マリントルーパーの\nセネルが言うくらいなんだもん、\n本当に泳ぐのが得意なんだね
traducao: If Senel the Marine Trooper says so,\nyou must be truly amazing\nat swimming!

original: 別に、わたしが\n特別っていうわけじゃないの
traducao: It's not that I'm particularly\nspecial or anything.

original: わたしの故郷では、これくらい\n泳げる人は一杯いたんだよ
traducao: Back in my hometown, there were lots\nof people who could swim this well.

original: そうなの？
traducao: Is that so?

original: うん。\n近くに、大きな湖があって……わたし達の\n生活と水は、密接に関わっていたから
traducao: Yeah.\nThere was a huge lake nearby, so water\nwas closely linked to our daily lives.

original: じゃあ、泳げない人はいないって事？
traducao: So nobody couldn't swim?

original: 上手かどうかは別にするなら\nみんな、泳ぐ事は出来たよ
traducao: Setting aside whether they were good,\neveryone knew how to swim.

original: 特に女性は、泳げない男性には\n見向きもしないって風習があって……
traducao: Women especially had a custom of not\neven looking twice at men who couldn't...

original: えっ！？　\nどうして？
traducao: Eh!?\nWhy is that?

original: うん。\n「水舞の儀式」っていう\n求愛の儀式があってね
traducao: Yeah.\nThere's a courtship ritual known\nas the "Water Dance Ritual."

original: 水の中で、求愛した人が相手を\n捕まえなくちゃいけないの。\nだから、泳ぐのが上手くないと……
traducao: In the water, the suitor has to catch\nthe person they're courting. So if\nthey aren't a skilled swimmer...

original: 好きな人と、結婚出来ない……ってこと！？
traducao: They can't marry who they love...?!

original: だからセネルもシャーリィも\n泳ぐのが上手なんだ……
traducao: So that's why both Senel and you\nare such great swimmers...

original: わぁ。\n見て見て、すっごい\nいいお天気！
traducao: Whoa!\nLook, look, the weather is\nabsolutely gorgeous!

original: 何だか、思いっきり\n体を動かしたくなっちゃうね
traducao: It really makes you want to move\nyour body with all your might!

original: そうだね。\nこんな日は、静かな湖で\n思いっきり泳ぎたいな……
traducao: You're right.\nOn days like this, I want to swim\nto my heart's content in a quiet lake...

original: 素敵！\nいいじゃない、それやってみよ！
traducao: Wonderful!\nThat sounds great, let's do it!

original: ええ？　\nでも、勝手に外出したら……
traducao: What?\nIf we go outside without permission...

original: 勝手に出なければいいんだよ。\nシャーリィだって泳ぎたいでしょ？
traducao: Then we just ask for permission!\nYou want to swim too, right, Shirley?

original: それは、そうだけど……
traducao: Well, that's true, but...

original: 日取りを決めて、みんなも誘って\nたまには気分転換しよ？\nねっ。約束！
traducao: Let's set a date, invite everyone,\nand refresh ourselves for a change!\nRight? It's a promise!

original: シャーリィ？　\nどうしたの？\nどこか痛いの？
traducao: Shirley?\nWhat's the matter?\nDoes something hurt?

original: ……う、ううん、そうじゃないよ
traducao: ...N-No, it's not that.

original: こうやって、誰かと一緒に遊ぶ\n約束をするの、久しぶりだな……って
traducao: It's just... promising to go have fun\nwith someone feels so long ago...

original: 故郷が、戦火で焼けてしまって\n友達と遊んだり、笑ったり……\nそういう事、なくなってたから……
traducao: After my home burned in the fires\nof war, playing with friends, laughing...\nAll that disappeared for me...

original: そっか……。\nシャーリィは悲しい事、\nたくさん経験して来たんだよね
traducao: I see...\nYou've experienced so many sad things,\nhaven't you, Shirley?

original: でも、大丈夫。\nこれからの事は、シャーリィが決められる
traducao: But don't worry.\nFrom now on, you get to decide your life.

original: 楽しい事も、嬉しい事も\nこれから一杯増やせるよ。\nでしょ？
traducao: Fun times, happy times, you can make\ncountless more from here on out.\nRight?

original: うん……
traducao: Yeah...

original: そうだね。\n……そうして、いきたいな
traducao: You're right.\n...I want to live that way.

original: さて。\nご飯の後は、しっかり歯を磨かないとね
traducao: Now then.\nAfter eating, we must brush our teeth!

original: 歯磨きすると、\n気分もリフレッシュするよね
traducao: Brushing your teeth really\nrefreshes your mood, doesn't it?

original: でもさでもさ〜、歯磨きすると、\nいい感じの後味も一緒に消えちゃって\n何かもったいないって感じしない？
traducao: But hey, hey~ If you brush, that yummy\naftertaste disappears right with it!\nDoesn't that feel kinda like a waste?

original: そうしたら、\nまた今度食べればいいんだもの
traducao: If that happens, you can just\neat it again next time.

original: ちゃんと歯磨きしないと〜……\n虫歯になっちゃうわよ？
traducao: If you don't brush properly...\nYou'll get cavities, you know?

original: そうだね。\n虫歯になると、歯だけじゃなくて\n体のあちこちに影響が出るって話だし……
traducao: That's true.\nI heard cavities don't just affect teeth,\nbut spread to parts all over the body...

original: そうそう、虫歯は大病の元とも言うし、\n放っておくと大変だもの。\n甘い物を食べた後は、特に要注意よね∀
traducao: Exactly, tooth decay causes big illness!\nLeave it alone and it's bad news.\nBe super careful after sweets!

original: うう……
traducao: Ugh...

original: 「フィリア特製フルーツパフェ・ウィズ・\n　チョコレートバナ〜ヌおいしおいし」の\nねっとりと濃厚な後味がぁ……
traducao: The thick, rich aftertaste of Philia's\nSpecial Fruit Parfait with Choco-Banana\nYum-Yum is fading away...!

traducao: Normal.\n

original: あめんぼ赤いなアイウエオ\n柿木栗の木カキクケコ\n大角豆に酢をかけサシスセソ
traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.
